description: Check a domain's mail authentication: SPF, DMARC (from a parent domain when the domain has no record of its own), DKIM, MX and MTA-STS, each check with pass, warn or fail and a severity.

dkim_selector.description: DKIM selector, such as google; without it the check tries the selectors of the domain's mail providers

name: email_auth_check

checks.description: The checks the answers allow, in a fixed order.

detail.description: It is a fixed sentence for the check and its result.

id.description: It is spf_record, spf_syntax, spf_lookup_limit, spf_all, spf_ignored_terms, spf_ptr, spf_wide_range, spf_record_size, dmarc_record, dmarc_policy, dmarc_test_mode, dmarc_reporting, dkim_key_found, dkim_key_usable, dkim_key_size, dkim_key_format, dkim_test_mode, dkim_key_restricted, dkim_multiple_keys, mx or mta_sts.

result.description: It is pass, warn or fail.

severity.description: It is high, medium or low, fixed for each check.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.

dkim.description: Its forms are as in spf.

key_status.description: It is found when a tested selector holds a key. not_found means the selector the caller gave holds none. unknown means none of the selectors the server picked holds one, so the domain may sign with another.

keys.description: The best key record of each selector that holds one.

key_type.description: The k tag, or rsa when the record has none.

state.description: It is present, revoked, unreadable or unknown_type.

test_mode.description: true when the key has t=y.

reason.description: The code says why the DNS question failed. It is server_error, truncated, malformed_answer, timeout, no_resolver, bad_question or not_public_name.

selector_source.description: It is given, provider or common. It says where the tested selectors come from.

usable_key_count.description: It counts the selectors whose key state is present.

dmarc.description: Its forms are as in spf.

aggregate_report_uris.description: It lists the first 8 addresses of the rua tag.

applied_policy.description: The policy a receiver applies to the domain's mail. null when no record applies. Also null when a policy tag is invalid and rua holds no valid address, since receivers then ignore the record.

domain_role.description: It is public_suffix, organizational, not_public_suffix or invalid, from the psd tag. null when the record lacks the tag.

failure_report_uris.description: It lists the first 8 addresses of the ruf tag.

nonexistent_subdomain_policy.description: It is none, quarantine, reject or invalid. null when the record lacks the tag.

policy.description: It is none, quarantine, reject or invalid. null when the record lacks the tag.

reason.description: The code says why the DNS question failed. It is server_error, truncated, malformed_answer, timeout, no_resolver, bad_question or not_public_name.

record_name.description: The DNS name of the record that applies. null when no record applies, and then every member below is null.

source.description: It is domain, organizational or public_suffix: whose record applies.

subdomain_policy.description: It is none, quarantine, reject or invalid. null when the record lacks the tag.

test_mode.description: true when the record has t=y.

mail_providers.description: The mail providers that the MX hosts and the SPF record name, each once.

mta_sts.description: Its forms are as in spf.

reason.description: The code says why the DNS question failed. It is server_error, truncated, malformed_answer, timeout, bad_question or not_public_name.

record_found.description: true when the MTA-STS name holds exactly one MTA-STS record.

mx.description: Its forms are as in spf.

hosts.description: It lists every other MX record.

null_mx.description: true when an MX record is a null MX, which says the domain takes no mail.

reason.description: The code says why the DNS question failed. It is server_error, truncated, malformed_answer, timeout or not_public_name.

no_mail_domain.description: true when the domain says it takes and sends no mail.

spf.description: available is false when the DNS question failed. Then only reason follows.

dns_lookup_term_count.description: It counts the terms that make a DNS lookup, as a receiver counts them. It covers this record only.

reason.description: The code says why the DNS question failed. It is server_error, truncated, malformed_answer, timeout or not_public_name.

record.description: null unless record_count is 1. terms and the three counts are then null too.

record_count.description: It counts the SPF records among the domain's TXT records.

terms.description: It holds the first 64 terms of the record.

kind.description: It is all, include, a, mx, ptr, ip4, ip6, exists, redirect, exp, unknown_modifier or invalid.

qualifier.description: It is pass, fail, softfail or neutral. null for a modifier and for an invalid term.

value.description: It is the text after the term's name. null when the term has none, such as -all.

unread_term_count.description: It counts the terms after the first 64, which terms leaves out.

title: Email Authentication Check (SPF, DMARC, DKIM)
